name: ZQUAS
tagline: Criminals use many banks. Now banks can act as one.
description: ZQUAS lets banks catch scam payments and mule accounts together, without pooling customer data. Built on a GPU governance engine that applies an institution's rules to decisions made by automated systems and AI agents. Alerts carry proofs a supervisor can verify.
stage: TRL 6, synthetic data only, no production deployments, pre-revenue

founder.name: Danny de Gier
founder.title: Founder & Engineer
founder.qualification: Professional Postgraduate Diploma in Financial Crime Compliance (ICA / University of Manchester)

benchmark.published_throughput: 750,000 complex events per second across a full 500,000-entity detection cycle; one unit is one entity evaluated against the full policy set, with attestation generation inside the measured path
benchmark.published_single_node_500k: 667 ms median of three runs for a 500,000-entity full detection cycle against the 56-policy catalogue, enforced under a 2-second regression bound in CI. NVIDIA RTX 5090, CUDA 13.1, Linux
benchmark.published_alert_lifecycle: under 10ms enforced (measured 7 to 8 ms for a single cold alert, 0.25 ms amortised per alert)
benchmark.published_federation_bilateral: under 10 seconds per bilateral round, bound enforced in CI (measured 3,052 ms at 100K entities per party; loopback development transport, not a real inter-participant network)
benchmark.published_vram_total: under 1 GB enforced (measured 562 to 616 MB peak, detection pass working set)
benchmark.policy_catalogue_pinned_by: static assertion to the catalogue array
benchmark.conditions: The 500,000-entity detection cycle is a median of three runs on NVIDIA RTX 5090, CUDA 13.1, Linux. Other figures were measured under different harness configurations and methodology is stated per figure, not globally.

federation.protocol: ECDH-PSI (X25519) + Yao's Garbled Circuits (Free-XOR) + IKNP OT Extension (Chou-Orlandi base OT on P-256)
federation.transport_note: loopback development transport; no real-network inter-participant measurement exists
federation.raw_data_shared: no raw or directly identifying customer data leaves the institution

proofs.independent_verification: public key plus proof bundle only; no reliance on the running production engine or its internal state

testing.test_count_note: No clean cross-platform figure exists. Unlike-platform counts are not added together.

capabilities.cross_institutional_detection: correspondent banking wire stripping validated end to end as a named cohort on synthetic data across simulated participants; trade-based over-invoicing, shell company layering and funnel account structuring designed and in scope, not validated

differentiators: Privacy-preserving cross-institutional detection via MPC (semi-honest security model)
Cryptographic proof bundles for every compliance decision (Ed25519 signed, Merkle-included)

Independent regulator verification: public key plus proof bundle, without relying on the running production engine or its internal state. The verifier is vendor-written and currently links the CUDA runtime; a CPU-only verifier is planned
Constitutional governance: agents cannot file SARs autonomously
Adversarial self-testing framework with continuous mutation testing
Approximately 753,000 source lines excluding third-party code

business_model.pricing: annual licensing by transaction volume and policy complexity
business_model.expansion: cross-institutional MPC network with network effects
business_model.data_sovereignty: no raw or directly identifying customer data leaves the institution

sandbox_results_synthetic.label: Synthetic data. In our model or in our test. Not real-world detection rates.
sandbox_results_synthetic.world: 1,000,000 adults at the UK scam rate
sandbox_results_synthetic.with_network_reviewed: about 1 in 2 in our model; about 1 in 3 with the generator's easiest clue removed
sandbox_results_synthetic.limits: at most 1 payment in 1,000 held and 1 in 500 reviewed; network signals add reviews, never automatic holds
sandbox_results_synthetic.crypto_exchanges_as_members: about a quarter more scam payments caught, in our model
sandbox_results_synthetic.scale_and_speed: up to 540 simulated bank installations on nine cloud GPUs in one cloud zone; 99 in 100 decisions in under 10 ms, in our test
